title.zh: 先证明 Koebe 映射单叶且归一化
title.en: Establish univalence and normalization of the Koebe map

given.zh: 取 k(z)=z/(1−z)²，定义域为开单位圆盘 D，因此分母在 D 内不为零。
given.en: Take k(z)=z/(1−z)² on the open unit disk D, where its denominator does not vanish.

claim.zh: k′(z)=(1+z)/(1−z)³，且 k 在 D 上单射、k(0)=0、k′(0)=1；所以 k 是 Schlicht。
claim.en: k′(z)=(1+z)/(1−z)³, k is injective on D, k(0)=0 and k′(0)=1. Thus k is Schlicht.

reason.zh: 商法则先对分子 z 和分母 (1−z)² 求导，再约去一个 1−z；D 内 z≠1，故约分合法。
reason.en: Apply the quotient rule to z and (1−z)², then cancel one factor 1−z, which is nonzero on D.

reason.zh: 两处分母都非零，可以交叉相乘；展开后一次项抵消，余式恰好分解为这两个因子。
reason.en: Both denominators are nonzero. Cross-multiply and expand: the first-order terms cancel, leaving these two factors.

statement.en: Since |zw|=|z||w|<1, one has 1−zw≠0 and therefore z=w.

reason.zh: 第二因子为零会迫使 |zw|=1，与两点都在开单位圆盘内矛盾，得到单射性。
reason.en: Vanishing of the second factor would force |zw|=1, contradicting that both points lie in the open unit disk. This proves injectivity.

statement.en: k(0)=0 and k′(0)=1; also k′(z)≠0 throughout D.

reason.zh: 代入导数公式得到归一化；导数为零只可能在 z=−1，而该点不在 D 内。这也为后续逆函数求导准备了非零条件。
reason.en: Substitution gives normalization. The derivative could vanish only at z=−1, outside D; this supplies the nonvanishing condition for later inverse differentiation.

title.zh: 用每个都贡献固定正面积积分的圆盘制造发散
title.en: Force divergence with disjoint balls of fixed positive integral contribution

given.en: Fix |a|=1, put rₙ=2⁻ⁿ and take Bₙ=B((1−rₙ)a,rₙ/4).

claim.zh: 这些圆盘位于 D 内且互不相交；若非负可测 F 在 Bₙ 上满足 F≥c(5rₙ/4)⁻²、c>0，则 ∫_D F=∞。特别地 ∫_D|z−a|⁻²=∞。
claim.en: The balls lie in D and are pairwise disjoint. If a nonnegative measurable F satisfies F≥c(5rₙ/4)⁻² on Bₙ for c>0, then ∫_D F=∞. In particular ∫_D|z−a|⁻²=∞.

reason.zh: 圆心模长为 1−rₙ，半径为 rₙ/4，rₙ=2⁻ⁿ∈(0,1]；用三角不等式即可。
reason.en: The center has modulus 1−rₙ, the radius is rₙ/4, and rₙ=2⁻ⁿ∈(0,1]. Apply the triangle inequality.

reason.zh: 圆心距边界点 a 恰好为 rₙ，所以整个小圆盘都落在以 a 为中心、半径 5rₙ/4 的范围内。
reason.en: The center is exactly rₙ from the boundary point a, placing the whole small ball within distance 5rₙ/4 of a.

statement.en: If n<m, then rₘ≤rₙ/2, and center distance rₙ−rₘ≥rₙ/2>rₙ/4+rₘ/4.

reason.zh: 半径和至多为 3rₙ/8，小于中心距，因此任意两个圆盘都不相交。
reason.en: The sum of radii is at most 3rₙ/8, strictly below the center distance, proving pairwise disjointness.

reason.zh: 半径缩小带来的面积因子 rₙ² 恰被奇性 rₙ⁻² 抵消；可测非负函数在不交集合上的积分可以相加。
reason.en: The area factor rₙ² exactly cancels the singular factor rₙ⁻². Integrals of a measurable nonnegative function add over disjoint sets.

title.zh: 在 +1 处得到 2/3 次面积矩发散
title.en: Obtain divergence of the 2/3 moment at +1

given.zh: 第 1 步给出 |k′|²ᐟ³=|1+z|²ᐟ³/|1−z|²，第 2 步给出 ∫_D|z−1|⁻²=∞。

reason.zh: 将 2 写成 (1+z)+(1−z)，使用反三角不等式，得到导数分子远离零的具体下界。
reason.en: Write 2=(1+z)+(1−z) and use the reverse triangle inequality to bound the derivative numerator away from zero.

reason.zh: 导数分母的三次幂乘上 2/3 得到临界二次幂；上一行保证分子的 2/3 次幂至少为一。
reason.en: The cubic denominator raised to 2/3 gives the critical inverse-square power, while the numerator power is at least one by the preceding bound.

reason.zh: 模型的圆盘总积分无穷，而远离 +1 的部分积分有限，因此无穷只能来自 U。
reason.en: The model has infinite integral on the disk but finite integral away from +1, so its integral on U must be infinite.

reason.zh: 先限制非负积分到 U，再使用已建立的逐点比较，便把模型的发散传给面积矩。
reason.en: Restrict the nonnegative integral to U, then apply the pointwise comparison to transfer the model divergence to the moment.

title.zh: 在 −1 处得到 −2 次面积矩发散
title.en: Obtain divergence of the −2 moment at −1

given.zh: 在朝向 a=−1 的 Bₙ 上有 |1+z|≤5rₙ/4，且 rₙ≤1。导数公式给出 |k′|⁻²=|1−z|⁶/|1+z|²。
given.en: On Bₙ directed toward a=−1, |1+z|≤5rₙ/4 and rₙ≤1. The derivative formula gives |k′|⁻²=|1−z|⁶/|1+z|².

statement.en: On the balls directed toward −1, |1+z|≤5rₙ/4≤5/4, hence |1−z|≥2−5/4=3/4.

reason.zh: rₙ≤1 给出统一常数界；2≤|1−z|+|1+z| 将它转成另一个因子的下界。
reason.en: Use rₙ≤1 for a uniform bound, then 2≤|1−z|+|1+z| to bound the other factor below.

reason.zh: 导数公式取负二次幂会交换分子分母；分子用统一正下界，分母用每个圆盘上的上界。
reason.en: Taking the negative second power of the derivative swaps numerator and denominator. Use the uniform lower bound upstairs and the ball-wise upper bound downstairs.

statement.zh: 取 c=(3/4)⁶，则每个 Bₙ 的积分至少为 cπ/25；因此 M(−2)=∞。
statement.en: With c=(3/4)⁶, every Bₙ contributes at least cπ/25; therefore M(−2)=∞.

reason.zh: c 严格为正且不随 n 改变，完全满足不交圆盘发散模型的假设。
reason.en: The constant c is strictly positive and independent of n, exactly meeting the disjoint-ball divergence criterion.

title.zh: 换元权重把逆映射的 p 次幂变为 2−p 次面积矩
title.en: The change-of-variable weight turns the inverse pth power into moment 2−p

given.zh: k 在 D 内单射，且 k′(z)≠0，因为 ±1 均不在 D 内。令 g 为它在 k(D) 上的逆。
given.en: The map k is injective on D and k′(z)≠0 because ±1 lie outside D. Let g be its inverse on k(D).

claim.zh: g′(k(z))=1/k′(z)，而 |det Dℝk(z)|=|k′(z)|²。因此 Jacobian 乘 |g′(k(z))|ᵖ 等于 |k′(z)|²⁻ᵖ。
claim.en: g′(k(z))=1/k′(z), while |det Dℝk(z)|=|k′(z)|². Thus the Jacobian times |g′(k(z))|ᵖ equals |k′(z)|²⁻ᵖ.

reason.zh: 单射给出逆函数，D 内 k′≠0 允许使用局部逆函数求导并除以 k′。
reason.en: Injectivity supplies the inverse, and k′≠0 on D permits local inverse differentiation and division by k′.

statement.zh: 若 k′=u+iv，则 Dℝk 的矩阵为 ((u,−v),(v,u))，行列式 u²+v²=|k′|²。
statement.en: If k′=u+iv, the matrix of Dℝk is ((u,−v),(v,u)), with determinant u²+v²=|k′|².

reason.zh: 复可微函数的实导数是复数乘法；直接计算这个 2×2 实矩阵的行列式，得到面积换元所需权重。
reason.en: The real derivative of a complex differentiable map is complex multiplication. Computing this real 2×2 determinant gives the area-change weight.

statement.en: |det Dℝk|·|g′∘k|ᵖ=|k′|²·|k′|⁻ᵖ=|k′|²⁻ᵖ; p=4 gives −2, and p=4/3 gives 2/3.

reason.zh: k′ 的模长为正，实数幂的乘法与逆幂运算合法；这两次代入把逆导数问题准确接到已知发散指数。
reason.en: Since |k′|>0, real-power multiplication and inversion apply. These substitutions match the inverse-derivative problems to the established divergent exponents.

title.zh: 换元排除可积性，汇合五个结论
title.en: Transfer divergence, exclude integrability and assemble the five conclusions

given.zh: k 在可测开集 D 上可微且单射；第 5 步给出两种 Jacobian 权重，第 3、4 步给出相应面积矩无穷。
given.en: The map k is differentiable and injective on measurable open D. Step 5 gives both Jacobian weights, and Steps 3–4 give the corresponding infinite moments.

claim.zh: |g′|⁴ 与 |g′|⁴ᐟ³ 在 k(D) 上都不可积；结合 Schlicht 与两个面积矩发散，得到 sharp_endpoints。
claim.en: |g′|⁴ and |g′|⁴ᐟ³ are both nonintegrable on k(D). Together with Schlicht and the two moment divergences, this proves sharp_endpoints.

reason.zh: k 在可测开圆盘内可微且单射，满足实二维非负积分换元公式的条件。
reason.en: The map is differentiable and injective on the measurable open disk, meeting the real two-dimensional change-of-variable assumptions for nonnegative integrals.

statement.en: For p=4 the right side is M(−2)=∞; for p=4/3 it is M(2/3)=∞.

reason.zh: 代入上一步的 Jacobian 权重等式，再分别使用 −1 和 +1 附近的发散结论。
reason.en: Substitute the Jacobian-weight identity and apply the divergence results at −1 and +1 respectively.

statement.zh: 若 |g′|ᵖ 在 k(D) 可积，则其非负积分有限，与上面的无穷值矛盾。
statement.en: If |g′|ᵖ were integrable on k(D), its nonnegative integral would be finite, contradicting the infinite value above.

reason.zh: 这一步由积分等式推出的是两种指定幂的不可积性，无须假定它们存在有限的普通积分。
reason.en: The integral equality proves nonintegrability of the two specified powers without assuming either ordinary integral is finite.

statement.en: sharp_endpoints combines Schlicht, M(−2)=∞, M(2/3)=∞, nonintegrability of |g′|⁴, and nonintegrability of |g′|⁴ᐟ³.

reason.zh: 五项结论各由前面的对应支线提供，将它们按原目标的合取顺序组装即可。
reason.en: The earlier branches provide the five conclusions, which are assembled in the conjunction order required by the target.
